M3 · Reveal — it works, peek the rest
M4 · Reveal — not quite, both explained

annotations.text:
Read with Plans/immersive-story-mode.md and the teardown research. Row 2: the golden path M1→M6. Row 3: the typed tier's honest states + the support system. Row 4: edges, recap, wide layouts, motion.

Drawn from shipped components: HalmOptionSelect cells, ReviewOptionSurface roles, GlassSurface, Theme tokens, AppAnimation springs, the word popup.

The data story, per the owner's three cases: (1) bundle ships story + TTS + can-do + optional authored acts[] — a deterministic derived floor means acts always exist. (2) PCC writes options + rationales ahead of play: act 1 in loading, acts 2–3 prefetched during round 1. (3) Cloud can't help → mission absent / silent per-round fallback / later on-device tier. Typed composer lines are the §8 gated tier — the one act-time PCC call.

M1 — §14.4: mode choice lives on the preview card, nowhere else (teardown: missions must never become their own tab). Framed as HOW to experience this story, not exercise types. Objectives previewed as speech acts. No AI branding — research: AI is a supporter, not a core.

M2a — first-act load management: at A1 the composer is folded into a visible door („from A2” pill — the unlock is shown, never punitive), and a one-time TipKit coach mark says the one thing that matters: tap a line; the lightbulb in the top-right helps and never counts against you.

M2 (A2+), state 1 of 2 — the three lines are BUTTONS: one tap answers, so words are not individually tappable there; word taps live only in the chat bubbles (dotted affordance). One chrome row: close · mission pill (title, chevron, act dots + count) · help lightbulb — no separate round indicator, no skip. Composer present, but the ä ö ü ß bar exists only in the keyboard state. The correct line is never marked before the tap.

M2b, state 2 of 2 — focusing the composer swaps states in one motion: keyboard up, ä ö ü ß bar above it, sentence starters for momentum, and the three lines fold into one quiet door. Blurring swaps back. Two clean states instead of one crowded surface. Typed lines are the gated §8 tier — PCC-graded with redaction and a char cap.

M3 — tap → rationale, synchronously (isCorrect is stored; no model at tap time). Focus collapse: siblings recede 0.35 / 0.96 — and stay tappable: the third line is peeked here, its „why it's weaker” unfolding from data already on the device. Curiosity never dead-ends. Say-it-back: the working line auto-plays once (settings + voice-quality gated).

M4 — §7.1 (owner-confirmed): wrong pick shows BOTH rationales in the same frame, correct line marked, no retry — two movements either way. Diff-view teaching: why yours fails + the line that works, one identical rationale string everywhere. Wrong picks never touch FSRS.

M5 — word taps live in chat bubbles, so the popup anchors to a word in the Bäckerin's line (system popover chrome, arrow to the word rect; opens below a word in the upper half). Headword SF bold; serif is reserved for the teal translation line. Keep (bookmark) is the only FSRS entry. Needs real TappedWordContext so separable verbs resolve.

M6 — the payoff: your line renders as YOUR bubble in the feed (alignment is the speaker cue; the freshest turn carries the brand stroke), every bubble replayable, then the authored story resumes — the pick never branches the plot. Objective ticks in the banner; counts, never percents.

M2c — the typed tier's wait, designed: composer locks, a quiet „Reading your message …” card with skeleton lines (the tap path still never waits — this state exists only for typed sends). Hard timeout returns the text to the field untouched; offline, the composer door simply isn't offered. Typed text is never lost to a failed call.

M2d — grade the speech act first, polish second: a green „it worked — she understood” before any correction, then ONE diff-style polish (hatte → hätte) with tap-for-why — never a wall of red. Typos don't fail a mission; perfection anxiety is the documented abandonment driver for free input.

M2e — off-errand input gets amber, never red: „Good German — different errand.” The mission line re-pins, the three lines re-offer themselves, and the typed text returns to the composer for editing. Correct German off the goal is not an error and grades nothing.

S1 — easy access to steps & progress: the mission banner is a button; this sheet is one tap away at any moment. Objectives are speech acts with deliberately vague hints („Ich hätte gern …”, Karte · bar) — orientation, not answers. Current step marked; done steps struck through; counts, never percents.

S2 — no wrong door, from the lightbulb in the banner: phrases with audio, translate her last message (shown quietly under the bubble), or „Wie bitte?” to make her repeat more simply. Asking for help never counts against you — no dead ends, no leaving the app to cheat (the #1 trust-killer in the research).

S3 — ready-made lines with audio, pack-authored per situation (deterministic — no FM). Tapping a phrase puts it in the composer, editable before sending, so using help still ends with the learner sending the line themselves. Every German word stays tappable.

M7 — §3: when PCC is unusable (offline / quota / cloud off in Settings) the mission is ABSENT with one quiet line why — the PCCQuotaBanner voice. Never present-and-failing. Decided once at lesson start; mid-lesson a missed prefetch degrades that round to plain Listen, silently.

M8 — mirrors the shipped lesson recap: eyebrow + serif headline + the flame count (words learned), YOU CAN NOW as the mission's can-do, lines-that-worked as a routed count, Words to review with dashed-suggest / solid-kept chips and one solid-brand Keep button (deliberate, never auto), and the engine-less next-story hand-off.

W1 — iPhone landscape: when height is scarce the bottom hint becomes a trailing act rail — same components, 44pt targets kept, feed keeps reading on the left. The chrome row (close · mission pill · help) is the same one as portrait; no umlaut bar until the keyboard opens.

W2 — regular width (iPad, unfolded fold): two panes — feed capped at the app's 700pt readable column, act rail beside it. Same chrome row: close · mission pill with act dots · help. On regular width the steps/help/phrases sheets present as popovers anchored to their buttons (the app's sheet-on-compact / popover-on-regular convention, same as the word popup).
